Scheduler's prepare_for_decode() early-returned because spec is\n        #    enabled — that meant EAGLE.draft() was expected to allocate the KV\n        #    slots. We're skipping draft, so run the full non-spec body now to\n        #    allocate (bs,) dense KV slots, advance seq_lens, set input_ids.\n        batch.prepare_for_decode(force_no_spec=True)\n\n        # 1. Target direct decode, capture LAST hidden so we can feed draft.\n        batch.return_hidden_states = True\n        model_worker_batch = batch.get_model_worker_batch()\n        model_worker_batch.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.LAST\n        target_result = self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(\n            model_worker_batch\n        )\n        last_hidden = target_result.logits_output.hidden_states\n        next_token_ids = target_result.next_token_ids\n        bs = next_token_ids.shape[0]\n\n        # 2. Mirror verify()'s post-sample bookkeeping: append accepted token,\n        #    run check_finished (process_batch_result_decode skips append for\n        #    spec algos), build unfinished mask.\n        next_token_cpu = next_token_ids.tolist()\n        unfinished_index: List[int] = []\n        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):\n            req.output_ids.append(next_token_cpu[i])\n            req.check_finished()\n            if not req.finished():\n                unfinished_index.append(i)\n            req.spec_verify_ct += 1\n\n        # 3. Park (token_id, hidden_state) in pending dict for unfinished reqs.\n        #    Finished reqs' pending entries are no longer needed — drop them\n        #    so we don't leak hidden state tensors across the run.\n        for i in unfinished_index:\n            rid = batch.reqs[i].rid\n            entry = self._no_spec_pending.get(rid)\n            if entry is None:\n                entry = {\"tokens\": [], \"hiddens\": []}\n                self._no_spec_pending[rid] = entry\n            entry[\"tokens\"].append(int(next_token_cpu[i]))\n            # Copy out of target output buffer; downstream may reuse the slot.\n            entry[\"hiddens\"].append(last_hidden[i].clone())\n        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):\n            if req.finished():\n                self._no_spec_pending.pop(req.rid, None)\n\n        # 4. Build a synthetic spec_info compatible with the rest of the\n        #    scheduler's spec-decoding contract: it must look as if 1 token was\n        #    \"verified\" per req. Fields not consumed downstream (topk_p, etc.)\n        #    stay None.\n        if not isinstance(batch.spec_info, EagleDraftInput):\n            batch.spec_info = EagleDraftInput()\n        si = batch.spec_info\n        si.verified_id = next_token_ids\n        si.hidden_states = last_hidden\n        si.accept_length = torch.zeros(\n            bs, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device\n        )\n        si.accept_length_cpu = [0] * bs\n        si.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.LAST\n\n        if len(unfinished_index) < bs:\n            keep = torch.tensor(\n                unfinished_index, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device\n            )\n            if si.topk_p is not None:\n                si.topk_p = si.topk_p[keep]\n            if si.topk_index is not None:\n                si.topk_index = si.topk_index[keep]\n            si.hidden_states = si.hidden_states[keep]\n            si.verified_id = si.verified_id[keep]\n            si.accept_length = si.accept_length[keep]\n            si.accept_length_cpu = [si.accept_length_cpu[i] for i in unfinished_index]\n\n        return GenerationBatchResult(\n            logits_output=target_result.logits_output,\n            next_token_ids=next_token_ids,\n            num_accepted_tokens=bs,\n            accept_length_per_req_cpu=[1] * bs,\n            can_run_cuda_graph=target_result.can_run_cuda_graph,\n        )\n\n    def _flush_no_spec_pending(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Catch-up draft KV after a NO_SPEC run.\n\n        Builds a multi-token DRAFT_EXTEND batch from accumulated pending\n        (token_id, last_hidden) per req, runs forward_draft_extend_after_decode\n        once, clears the pending dict.\n\n        Reqs added during NO_SPEC via prefill (extend) already have draft KV\n        in sync — they'll have no pending entry and are skipped.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self._no_spec_pending:\n            return\n\n        # Collect per-req pending in batch.reqs order. Drop reqs with empty\n        # pending (newly merged or filtered by check_finished elsewhere).\n        active_idx: List[int] = []\n        per_req_tokens: List[List[int]] = []\n        per_req_hiddens: List[List[torch.Tensor]] = []\n        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):\n            entry = self._no_spec_pending.get(req.rid)\n            if entry is None or not entry[\"tokens\"]:\n                continue\n            active_idx.append(i)\n            per_req_tokens.append(entry[\"tokens\"])\n            per_req_hiddens.append(entry[\"hiddens\"])\n\n        if not active_idx:\n            self._no_spec_pending.clear()\n            return\n\n        # Per-req pending counts may differ if NO_SPEC entered while some\n        # reqs were still mid-prefill. Build a mixed-length DRAFT_EXTEND.\n        accept_length_cpu = [len(t) - 1 for t in per_req_tokens]  # extend_lens = +1\n        accept_length = torch.tensor(\n            accept_length_cpu, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device\n        )\n        flat_tokens = torch.tensor(\n            [tok for lst in per_req_tokens for tok in lst],\n            dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device,\n        )\n        flat_hiddens = torch.cat(\n            [torch.stack(lst, dim=0) for lst in per_req_hiddens], dim=0\n        )\n\n        # If a strict subset of batch.reqs needs catch-up, build an aligned\n        # sub-batch view (req_pool_indices / seq_lens slices to active rows).\n        # batch is mutated by prepare_extend_after_decode and restored after.\n        if len(active_idx) == len(batch.reqs):\n            target_batch = batch\n            req_pool_indices = batch.req_pool_indices\n            seq_lens = batch.seq_lens\n            seq_lens_cpu = batch.seq_lens_cpu\n        else:\n            keep = torch.tensor(active_idx, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device)\n            target_batch = copy(batch)\n            target_batch.reqs = [batch.reqs[i] for i in active_idx]\n            req_pool_indices = batch.req_pool_indices[keep]\n            seq_lens = batch.seq_lens[keep]\n            seq_lens_cpu = batch.seq_lens_cpu[active_idx]\n            target_batch.req_pool_indices = req_pool_indices\n            target_batch.seq_lens = seq_lens\n            target_batch.seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens_cpu\n            target_batch.sampling_info = SamplingBatchInfo.from_schedule_batch(\n                target_batch, target_batch.model_config.vocab_size\n            )\n\n        si = EagleDraftInput()\n        si.verified_id = flat_tokens\n        si.hidden_states = flat_hiddens\n        si.accept_length = accept_length\n        si.accept_length_cpu = accept_length_cpu\n        si.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.LAST\n        si.seq_lens_for_draft_extend = seq_lens.clone()\n        si.seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu = seq_lens_cpu.clone()\n        si.req_pool_indices_for_draft_extend = req_pool_indices\n        target_batch.spec_info = si\n\n        with self.draft_tp_context(\n            self.draft_model_runner.tp_group\n        ), speculative_moe_backend_context(), speculative_moe_a2a_backend_context():\n            self.forward_draft_extend_after_decode(target_batch)\n\n        # Propagate the catch-up's spec_info (topk_p / topk_index / hidden /\n        # verified_id) back onto the live batch so the next draft() step picks\n        # up the up-to-date draft state. align_batch_for_draft_extend wasn't\n        # used so the shapes already match the active reqs subset.\n        batch.spec_info = target_batch.spec_info\n        self._no_spec_pending.clear()"
```json
}
```

## 回应「双阈值拉高 S1」

**对，思路对，并且这是当前架构本来就支持的**——env 变量已经把 D7 的所有 spec 参数独立出来了：

```
EAGLE_D7_TOPK=2 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=3 EAGLE_D7_DTN=7   # 默认
```

S1 全程 bs=1 → 全程走 D7。所以**直接调 D7 参数就能特化 S1**，不影响 D5 / NO_SPEC：

- `EAGLE_D7_STEPS=4, EAGLE_D7_TOPK=2, EAGLE_D7_DTN=9` — 深一层
- `EAGLE_D7_STEPS=5, EAGLE_D7_TOPK=2, EAGLE_D7_DTN=11`

**但有约束**（来自当前 capture 设计）：
1. 整个 target cuda graph 的 buffer 按 `max(D5_dtn, D7_dtn)` 分配。把 D7_dtn 推到 11 意味着所有 bs 的 verify 输入 buffer 都按 11×max_bs 算，显存↑、capture 时间↑。
2. accept_rate 长 chain 衰减：dtn=7 → dtn=9 不是白拿 2 个 token，要看后两位 token 的接受率。如果 accept_rate@dtn=9 < 7/9，反而吃亏（每步 verify 多花 2/7 ≈ 28% 时间，但接受 token 没相应增加）。
3. cudnn FlashInfer prefill plan 在某些 dtn 上有 tile 选择问题（之前 mars verify 时遇到过），新 dtn 要测一下。

**最佳验证流程**：
1. 先确认现在 #1+#2+#3 改动正常（mini_bench 跑通）
2. 然后扫 D7 配置：`(steps=3, dtn=7)` baseline → `(steps=4, dtn=9)` → `(steps=5, dtn=11)`，**只看 S1 的 output_tput / accept_length**
3. 选 accept_length × tput 最高那个

> AGENT

理解了——降低 **MARS verify 的 theta 阈值**，让 D7（bs=1，S1 全程）更激进地接受 draft token。S1 全程都在 D7 模式 → 每个 step 接受更多 token → throughput 飞起。D5 / NO_SPEC 不受影响。

**当前架构的限制**：`_MARS_THETA` 是 `eagle_info.py` module-level 全局常量（line 26），进程启动时读一次 `EAGLE_MARS_THETA` env 就定下来了。所有 mode 共用一个 theta。

**改造方案**：
1. `spec_mode.py` 加 `d5_mars_theta` / `d7_mars_theta` 字段（env: `EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA` / `EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA`），fallback 到现有 `EAGLE_MARS_THETA`。
2. `_apply_spec_config` 进 D5/D7 时同步把 `eagle_info._MARS_THETA` 切到对应值（module-level 写）。
3. `verify` 路径继续读 `_MARS_THETA`（line 345），自然拿到当前 mode 的 theta。

**收益预期**：D7 theta 从 0.85 降到 0.7 / 0.6 → MARS 接受条件 `z2/z1 > theta` 更松 → 每步 chain 上多接受 1-2 个 top2 token → S1 accept_length ↑ → output_tput ↑。

**风险**：质量下降。MARS theta 越低越容易接受非 argmax token，文本可能有低概率漂移。但 SOAR 评测是输出+答案对照，少量漂移不一定扣分；激进 theta + 高 throughput 可能净赚。

## 改动总结

| 文件 | 变化 |
|---|---|
| `spec_mode.py` | `SpecModeConfig` 增加 `d5_mars_theta` / `d7_mars_theta` 字段；新增 `effective_d5_theta()` / `effective_d7_theta()` helper（-1 时 fallback 到全局 `mars_theta`） |
| `eagle_worker.py:_apply_spec_config` | 切模式时同步写 `eagle_info._MARS_THETA`，verify 路径每步读这个 module-level 值 |
| `start_eagle.sh` | 暴露 `EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA` / `EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA` env，默认 `-1` 表示沿用全局 |

## 用法

S1 激进、其他保持稳健：

```bash
EAGLE_DYNAMIC_MODE=1 \
EAGLE_MARS_THETA=0.85 \      # D5 / NO_SPEC fallback
EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA=0.6 \    # D7 (bs=1, S1) 激进
bash eval/start_eagle.sh
```

或者更激进：`EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA=0.4`，甚至 `0.0`（z2 > 0 就接受）。

## 验证流程建议

1. 先起服 baseline（不设 D7_MARS_THETA，全局 0.85）跑一次 S1，记 output_tput / accept_length
2. 设 `EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA=0.7` 再起服跑 S1
3. 设 `EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA=0.5` 再起服跑 S1
4. 看哪个 theta 的 output_tput 最高，且 accept_length 提升明显

[2026-04-28 05:44:27] [spec-mode] EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA='--0.85' not float, fallback -1.000000 怎么理解

> AGENT

bash 的 `${VAR:-default}` 语法解析问题。

你写的是：
```bash
EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA:---0.85}"   # ← 三个 -
EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA:--0.5}"     # ← 两个 -
```

bash 解析方式：`:-` 是"未设置时取默认值"的分隔符，**后面剩下的整段都是默认值字面量**。所以：

- `${...:---0.85}` → 默认值是 `"--0.85"`（多了一个 `-`），不是合法 float → spec_mode 解析失败 fallback `-1`
- `${...:--0.5}` → 默认值是 `"-0.5"` ✓（合法 float，但 < 0 → effective_d7_theta() 看到负数 → fallback 到全局 `EAGLE_MARS_THETA=0.85`，没起到激进 D7 的作用）

正确写法（默认值前**不**多打 `-`）：

```bash
EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA:-0.85}" \
EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA:-0.5}" \
```

含义：
- `EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA=0.85` → D5 用 0.85
- `EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA=0.5` → D7 用 0.5（更激进）
- 都 `>= 0`，effective 直接返回它们本身

如果想表达"沿用全局 fallback"（-1），bash 写法是：
```bash
EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA="${EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA:--1}"   # default = "-1"
```
（`:-` 后面紧跟默认值字面量 `-1`，看着像三个连字符但只有一个分隔符 + 一个负号）

这是 `torch.compile` 的**重编译次数上限警告**，不是 bug，**不影响正确性**。

## 是什么

`spec_utils.py:466` 上的 `select_top_k_tokens` 用了 `@torch.compile(dynamic=True)` —— EAGLE draft 每个 spec step 调一次的小算子组合（top-k 候选选择）。

`torch.compile` 会按 input 类型/shape 做 trace specialization，每次新组合就编译一份 graph，缓存到 8 个（默认 `recompile_limit=8`）。超过就放弃缓存，**回退到 eager Python 执行**，并发出这条 warning。

## 为什么我们触发了

`select_top_k_tokens` 内部分支 `if hidden_states is not None:` —— hidden_states 既能是 tensor 也能是 None。

我们的 dynamic mode 引入了多套 capture 路径：
- D5 dummy spec_info（dtn=5, topk=2, steps=2）
- D7 dummy spec_info（dtn=7, topk=2, steps=3）
- 默认 / DECODE / NO_SPEC fast path

每条路径在 step 0 调用时 `(i=0, hidden_states=None)`，step >= 1 是 `(i, hidden_states=tensor)`，再叠加不同 dtn / topk 的 shape 组合 → dynamo 看到 8 种以上 specialization → 命中 limit。

最后一条 `last reason: 0/7: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'size'` 表明第 8 次 trace 时 hidden_states 变成 None，跟前一份 cached graph 假设的 tensor 类型冲突。

## 影响

`select_top_k_tokens` 之后的调用走 **eager Python**，不再被 dynamo 优化。差距通常 ~10-50us / spec step。bench 对比一下实际数字就能看出有没有可见退化。

## 要不要修

- **不修**：忽略 warning，bench 数字如果可接受就这样。
- **简单修**：把 limit 提高，让所有 specialization 都缓存。在 `eagle_worker.py` 顶部加：
  ```python
  import torch._dynamo
  torch._dynamo.config.recompile_limit = 32
  ```
  或 launch 前 export `TORCH_DYNAMO_RECOMPILE_LIMIT=32`（如果该 env 被识别）。
- **根治**：把 `@torch.compile` 拆掉，或保证 hidden_states 永远是 tensor。改动面比较大且收益不一定值。

我建议**先 bench 看数字**，如果 S1 / S8 没退化就忽略；有退化再提 limit。

d5和d7的 topk dtn 是固定的还是可改的？

> AGENT

可改，全部 env 驱动：

```bash
EAGLE_D5_TOPK   (默认 2)
EAGLE_D5_STEPS  (默认 2)
EAGLE_D5_DTN    (默认 5)
EAGLE_D7_TOPK   (默认 2)
EAGLE_D7_STEPS  (默认 3)
EAGLE_D7_DTN    (默认 7)
```

约束（违反会出问题，不只是 warning）：

1. **chain verify 等式**：`dtn == 1 + topk * steps`。`spec_mode.py:_validate` 会 warn 但不拦截；不满足 organize_draft_results 输出形状会错乱。S1/S8 几乎一定崩。

2. **D7_DTN ≥ D5_DTN**：当前架构把 D7_DTN 当作 max dtn，所有 cuda graph 输入 buffer 按 max 分配。如果反过来（D5 比 D7 大），capture 会过小 buffer。如果 D5_DTN == D7_DTN，cuda_graph_runner 会跳过 D5 capture 流，全部用默认 verify graph（自动处理）。

3. **D7 buffer scope**：`init_cuda_graphs` 里 D7 runner 用 `cap_max_bs=1`（只 capture bs=1），写死在代码里。如果要让 D7 支持 bs > 1，要把 `cap_max_bs=1` 改掉，并且把 `EAGLE_D7_BS` 阈值也调高。

4. **改 dtn 后必须重启 server**：env 在启动时读，buffer 在 capture 时定型。

**典型激进 S1 配置**（保持 chain verify 等式）：
```bash
EAGLE_D7_TOPK=2 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=4 EAGLE_D7_DTN=9    # 深一层
EAGLE_D7_TOPK=2 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=5 EAGLE_D7_DTN=11   # 再深
EAGLE_D7_TOPK=3 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=2 EAGLE_D7_DTN=7    # 横向更宽
```

D5 改大 dtn 会增加 max=D7_DTN（如果 D5 > D7），引发整个 buffer 重新设计，**不推荐改 D5 超过 D7**。

> AGENT

报错根因：**D5 和 D7 的 `topk` 不一样导致 draft attention backend 的 buffer 错位**。

## 怎么发生的

你这次配置 `D5_TOPK=2`、`D7_TOPK=3`。Draft 的每次 step forward 处理 `bs * topk` 个 token。

eagle_worker init 时按 `max(d5_topk, d7_topk) = 3` 创建 draft attention backend（buffer plan 按 64 × 3 = 192 token）。

D5 capture 时，我把 runner 的 `topk` 临时 override 成 2，runner 自己的 `input_ids` buffer 按 64 × 2 = 128 分配，并以 128 token 的 shape 跑 model forward。但底下的 attention backend 仍记得 plan 是 192 → flashinfer decode_wrapper 的 batch_size 算成 192，实际拿到 128 → 报这个错。

```
q.shape[0] (128) does not match batch_size * q_len_per_req (192 * 1 = 192)
```

128 = 64 × **D5_topk(2)**；192 = 64 × **max_topk(3)**。

## 规避方案

**保持 `D5_TOPK == D7_TOPK`，只调 steps**。S1 激进的等价配置：

| 组合 | TOPK | STEPS | DTN | 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D7_STEPS=3 | 2 | 3 | 7 | 默认 |
| D7_STEPS=4 | 2 | 4 | 9 | 深一层 |
| D7_STEPS=5 | 2 | 5 | 11 | 再深 |

DTN 自动按 `1 + topk * steps` 配。这种只增 steps 的扩展不会触发 backend buffer mismatch。

## 想真正支持 topk 不同的话

需要为 D5 / D7 **各自维护独立 draft attention backend**（不共享 plan / cuda graph state），改动面比较大（要在 worker 上多保存一份 backend 引用，按 mode 切换）。值不值得做取决于你想不想试 D7_TOPK=3 这种"宽 chain"。**先建议直接试增 steps 路线**，省事且大概率收益已经够。

要不要我把 `D5_TOPK == D7_TOPK` 这条约束加到 `spec_mode._validate`，让违规直接报错而不是跑到 capture 才崩？

> AGENT

找到 bug 了。

stack trace：`self.topk_p[:raw_bs].copy_(forward_batch.spec_info.topk_p)` shape (max_bs, 3) vs (bs, **2**)。

## 根因

`eagle_worker.__init__` 在 dynamic mode 下：
1. 先 backup 当前的 `self.topk` (默认 `server_args.speculative_eagle_topk` = 2，来自命令行 `--speculative-eagle-topk 2`)
2. 改成 `max(d5_topk, d7_topk)` = 3 用来 capture cuda graph
3. capture 完，**restore `self.topk = backup = 2`** ← 问题在这

restore 之后 prefill 走 `forward_draft_extend → capture_for_decode → fast_topk(probs, self.topk=2)` → `spec_info.topk_p` shape `(bs, 2)`。

第一次 decode 进入 D5 / D7 mode，`_apply_spec_config` 改 `self.topk=3`，但**之前那个 prefill 产出的 spec_info 还是按 topk=2 形状的**，draft cuda graph runner 期望 (bs, 3) → mismatch。

## 修

不该 restore。dynamic 模式下 `self.topk` 由 `_apply_spec_config` 动态切，restore 反而把 prefill 路径打破。

> AGENT

找到根因了。

## 诊断

正常 EAGLE3 spec 路径下，每次 step 末尾 `forward_draft_extend_after_decode` 会跑一次 draft 模型，并通过 `capture_for_decode` 把 `spec_info.hidden_states` 设为 **draft 模型输出**（`(bs, draft_hidden_size=4096)`）。这是这个字段对外的不变量。

我的 NO_SPEC lazy fast path **跳过了 draft 的执行**，但把 target 的 `last_hidden`（EAGLE3 aux 拼接 = `4096*3=12288`）写进了 `batch.spec_info.hidden_states`。结果：
- running batch（NO_SPEC 持续）：hidden = 12288
- 新 prefill batch（走完 forward_draft_extend）：hidden = 4096
- merge 时 cat 沿 dim 0 失败（dim 1 mismatch）

## 修

NO_SPEC 期间 `batch.spec_info.hidden_states` 这个字段不会被任何路径消费（draft 没跑），只是为了 merge/filter 兼容存在。target 的 12288 hidden 真实数据已经累积到 `self._no_spec_pending` 里，不需要在 spec_info 上保留。

把它设成 `None`，让 merge_batch 走它已有的 None 分支。

修好了。核心改动：

1. **NO_SPEC step 末尾用 zero placeholder** `(bs, draft_hidden_size)` 替代之前的 12288 target aux hidden — 保证和 normal path 末尾的 spec_info shape 一致
2. **topk_p / topk_index 也补 placeholder**（首次进 NO_SPEC 时如果还没值），shape 用 `self.topk`（当前 mode 的 topk）保证 cat 兼容
3. **filter 段移除 None check**（现在保证非 None）

真实的 12288 hidden 仍然累积在 `self._no_spec_pending` 里，flush 时正确喂给 draft。

请重启服务再跑：

```bash
EAGLE_D7_TOPK=3 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=3 EAGLE_D7_DTN=10 \
```

> DEVELOPER

是不是吞吐最优？ 有没有拖慢吞吐？

> AGENT

不是最优，有 hot path 浪费。

## 找到了浪费

每个 NO_SPEC step 都在 hot path 上：

```python
si.hidden_states = torch.zeros((bs, 4096), bf16, device=self.device)   # 471KB GPU alloc
si.accept_length = torch.zeros(bs, int32, device=self.device)          # 256B GPU alloc
si.topk_p = torch.zeros((bs, topk), fp32, device)  # 仅首次（小）
si.topk_index = torch.zeros((bs, topk), int64, device)  # 仅首次（小）
```

这两个 `torch.zeros` 在 GPU 上**每步分配新内存**。bs=58 一步 = ~471KB hidden + 256B accept_length。GPU caching allocator 会复用，但仍然是 host-launched fill kernel + metadata 创建，每步 50-200us 浪费。

而且这俩 placeholder **内容永远不被读**——下次进 D5/D7 时 `_flush_no_spec_pending` 整体重设 spec_info；continued NO_SPEC step 也只是再覆盖一遍。它们存在的唯一目的是让 `merge_batch` 的 cat 在 dim 1 形状对齐。

## 改成预分配 + view

预分配到 `max_running_requests` 大小，每步 `[:bs]` view —— 零分配。

还有一处 hot path 浪费要修：`last_hidden[i].clone()` 在 bs 个 req 上各跑一次 GPU clone（每次 24KB）—— 改成一次 batched clone 即可：

```json
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_worker.py",
  "old_string": "        # 3. Park (token_id, hidden_state) in pending dict for unfinished reqs.\n        #    Finished reqs' pending entries are no longer needed — drop them\n        #    so we don't leak hidden state tensors across the run.\n        for i in unfinished_index:\n            rid = batch.reqs[i].rid\n            entry = self._no_spec_pending.get(rid)\n            if entry is None:\n                entry = {\"tokens\": [], \"hiddens\": []}\n                self._no_spec_pending[rid] = entry\n            entry[\"tokens\"].append(int(next_token_cpu[i]))\n            # Copy out of target output buffer; downstream may reuse the slot.\n            entry[\"hiddens\"].append(last_hidden[i].clone())\n        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):\n            if req.finished():\n                self._no_spec_pending.pop(req.rid, None)",
  "new_string": "        # 3. Park (token_id, hidden_state) in pending dict for unfinished reqs.\n        #    Finished reqs' pending entries are no longer needed — drop them\n        #    so we don't leak hidden state tensors across the run.\n        #    Single batched clone of unfinished rows (one GPU memcpy kernel)\n        #    instead of bs individual .clone() calls.\n        if unfinished_index:\n            keep_idx = torch.tensor(\n                unfinished_index, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device\n            )\n            unfinished_hiddens = last_hidden[keep_idx].clone()\n            for k, i in enumerate(unfinished_index):\n                rid = batch.reqs[i].rid\n                entry = self._no_spec_pending.get(rid)\n                if entry is None:\n                    entry = {\"tokens\": [], \"hiddens\": []}\n                    self._no_spec_pending[rid] = entry\n                entry[\"tokens\"].append(int(next_token_cpu[i]))\n                entry[\"hiddens\"].append(unfinished_hiddens[k])\n        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):\n            if req.finished():\n                self._no_spec_pending.pop(req.rid, None)"
```

> AGENT

现在 hot path 干净了。两个优化：

1. **预分配 placeholder buffer** — `_no_spec_hidden_buf` 等四个 buffer 在 `__init__` 一次性 alloc 到 `(max_running_requests, ...)`。每个 NO_SPEC step 只做 `[:bs]` view（零分配）。

2. **批量 clone hidden** — 之前每 req 一次 `last_hidden[i].clone()`，bs=58 时 58 次 GPU memcpy kernel；现在 `last_hidden[unfinished_idx].clone()` 一次 kernel 搞定，下方循环用 view 切片。

## 当前 _forward_no_spec hot path 分解

| 操作 | 频次/step | 必需性 |
|---|---|---|
| target forward | 1 | ✓ 必需 |
| `next_token_ids.tolist()` | 1 | ✓ 必需（spec path 也 sync） |
| Python 循环 bs 次（append + check_finished） | bs | ✓ 必需，与 normal spec 等价 |
| 一次 batched clone `last_hidden[idx]` | 1 | ✓ 必需（target buffer 会被覆盖） |
| 字典 dict append | bs Python 操作 | ✓ 必需 |
| spec_info placeholder slice | 4 次 view | 零开销 |
| finished filter 段 | 仅有 req 完成时跑 | ✓ |

剩下的开销都是**无法消除的必需操作**（target forward + sync + Python loop bookkeeping）。**没有可压榨的余地**。

NO_SPEC step 多余开销现在估算：< 50us/step（仅 Python 循环 + 一次 batched clone），相对 step 总时间 5-10ms 占比 < 1%。

可以重启测了。

> AGENT

不是 prefill "吃不下"，是 **KV pool 容量限制**导致的 backpressure，且 **accept_rate 异常低**让吞吐进一步劣化。让我拆开看：

## 1. 并发上限 = KV pool，不是 max_running_requests

| 指标 | 观察值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `max_running_requests` | 64（命令行设的） | 软上限 |
| `full token usage` | 经常到 0.92-0.99 | **KV pool 是真瓶颈** |
| `mamba usage` | 长期 0.61 (= 39/64) | mamba pool 还有 1/3 空间 |
| `#running-req` | 卡在 38-40 | 不是 64 |
| `#queue-req` | 20-30 | 一直堵 |

每个 prefill `+8192 token`，每个 decode `+1 token/step`。running reqs 跑了一段后平均 ~26k token → 39 reqs ≈ 1M token = KV pool 总容量（1.13M）的 91%。再加 prefill 就溢，调度器主动拒。

## 2. accept_rate 异常低（0.08），spec 等于没用

```
accept len: 2.00, accept rate: 0.08
```

D7 chain dtn=10 的话，`accept_rate ≈ accepted_drafts / 9 = 0.08` → 平均每步只 accept ~0.7 个 draft token。正常 chain D7 应该 0.3-0.5（即 accept_len 3-5）。

**等于 spec 没起作用**，2500 tok/s 是裸 target decode（NO_SPEC）的吞吐。本来 D7+S1 想冲的高吞吐根本没出来。

## 3. 还有：**cuda graph: False**

每步都报 `cuda graph: False`，说明 decode 完全 fallback eager，更慢。这是个独立的红灯——D5/D7 graph 没被命中。

可能原因：
- `_apply_spec_config` 切的 runner 跟 forward_batch 当前 mode 对不上
- `replay_prepare` 的 graph_kind 缓存出 bug
- spec_info 的字段不齐，`can_run` return False

## 诊断建议（按优先级）

**A. cuda graph: False 必须先解决**。这是 NO_SPEC 状态的判定，看 `cuda_graph_runner.can_run` 在哪条 if return False。grep 一下日志看有没有 `recapture_if_needed` 或 capture_hidden_mode 不匹配的提示。

**B. accept_rate 0.08 排查**。可以临时把 `EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA=0.85` 改回保守值，看 accept_rate 是否回到 0.3+。如果回得来，说明 D7_MARS_THETA=0.5 太激进；如果还低，说明 lazy catch-up 把 draft KV 弄错了。

**C. 64 并发不现实**。即使 spec 工作正常，KV pool 1.13M 容纳不下 64 reqs × ~26k token。要么扩 `mem_fraction_static`（0.75 → 0.85），要么短 prompt / 短 generation。

> AGENT

调查结果，**两个独立 bug**：

## Bug 1：NO_SPEC 的 cuda graph 不命中（你那一句没胡说）

- target cuda_graph_runner 顺序 capture：默认 verify (FULL) → D5 verify (FULL/LAST) → DECODE (FULL)
- 但每个分支末尾都 `restore saved_hidden_mode`，最终 `self.capture_hidden_mode = FULL`（来自 verify EagleVerifyInput default）
- NO_SPEC fast path 我设的是 `LAST`
- `capture_hidden_mode_matches`：`LAST != FULL` → can_run False → eager fallback

NO_SPEC 在 DECODE forward mode 下每 req 1 token，FULL 跟 LAST 等价，应该请求 FULL。

## Bug 2：_flush 的 out_cache_loc is None

`_flush_no_spec_pending` 在 `_apply_spec_config` 之后、`self.draft()` 之前调用。但 spec mode 下 scheduler 的 `prepare_for_decode` **不 alloc cache**（spec 路径里 cache 是 EAGLE.draft 内部 alloc 的）。

`_flush` 想跑 multi-token draft prefill，但 batch 没有任何 cache slot。

## 决策

#3 lazy catch-up 设计在 cache 生命周期上有问题：`_flush` 只能在 spec path **走过 verify 之后**调用（那时 slots 才合法），不能在 draft 之前调用。这个修要重写整个 hook 点，工程量不小。

我建议**撤回 #3 lazy 部分**（回到每步 `forward_draft_extend_after_decode`），保留 #1+#2，外加修 Bug 1。这样：
- 系统先稳定能跑
- spec 真正工作（accept_rate 不会再 0.08）
- cuda graph 命中
- lazy 优化等之后单独严谨实现

Scheduler's prepare_for_decode() early-returned because spec is\n        #    enabled — that meant EAGLE.draft() was expected to allocate the KV\n        #    slots. We're skipping draft, so run the full non-spec body now to\n        #    allocate (bs,) dense KV slots, advance seq_lens, set input_ids.\n        batch.prepare_for_decode(force_no_spec=True)\n\n        # 1. Target direct decode, capture FULL hidden so we can feed draft.\n        #    Why FULL not LAST: target's cuda_graph_runner ends capture with\n        #    self.capture_hidden_mode=FULL (last value set during verify\n        #    capture path; EagleVerifyInput.capture_hidden_mode default=FULL).\n        #    can_run() requires requested == self.capture_hidden_mode, so a\n        #    LAST request misses the captured graph and falls back to eager\n        #    (the \"cuda graph: False\" we observed). Under DECODE forward mode\n        #    each req has 1 token, so FULL collapses to the same (bs, hidden)\n        #    tensor as LAST — semantically equivalent for downstream draft.\n        batch.return_hidden_states = True\n        model_worker_batch = batch.get_model_worker_batch()\n        model_worker_batch.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.FULL\n        target_result = self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(\n            model_worker_batch\n        )\n        last_hidden = target_result.logits_output.hidden_states\n        next_token_ids = target_result.next_token_ids\n        bs = next_token_ids.shape[0]\n\n        # 2. Stash a synthetic \"verify accepted 1 token\" spec_info on the batch\n        #    so forward_draft_extend_after_decode() can consume it normally.\n        if not isinstance(batch.spec_info, EagleDraftInput):\n            batch.spec_info = EagleDraftInput()\n        batch.spec_info.verified_id = next_token_ids\n        batch.spec_info.hidden_states = last_hidden\n        # accept_length here = \"extra accepted draft tokens beyond the user_4813494d\".\n        # NO_SPEC has no draft tree, only the 1 user_4813494d token in next_token_ids,\n        # so accept_length must be 0 — prepare_extend_after_decode does\n        # extend_lens = [x + 1 for x in accept_length_cpu], and verified_id\n        # has bs elements; mismatched extend_lens leaks draft KV slots.\n        batch.spec_info.accept_length = torch.zeros(\n            bs, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device\n        )\n        batch.spec_info.accept_length_cpu = [0] * bs\n        batch.spec_info.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.LAST\n        # prepare_extend_after_decode reads these to set batch.seq_lens etc.\n        batch.spec_info.seq_lens_for_draft_extend = batch.seq_lens.clone()\n        batch.spec_info.seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu = batch.seq_lens_cpu.clone()\n        batch.spec_info.req_pool_indices_for_draft_extend = batch.req_pool_indices\n\n        # 3. Advance draft KV by 1 token so spec resumption is seamless.\n        #    forward_draft_extend_after_decode → capture_for_decode resets\n        #    spec_info.hidden_states to draft-output size (~4096), restoring\n        #    the merge_batch invariant.\n        with self.draft_tp_context(\n            self.draft_model_runner.tp_group\n        ), speculative_moe_backend_context(), speculative_moe_a2a_backend_context():\n            self.forward_draft_extend_after_decode(batch)\n\n        # 4. Mirror verify()'s post-sample bookkeeping: append accepted token,\n        #    run check_finished (otherwise NO_SPEC reqs never finish because\n        #    process_batch_result_decode skips append for spec algos), then\n        #    filter spec_info to unfinished only so the next filter_batch\n        #    pass sees matching shapes.\n        next_token_cpu = next_token_ids.tolist()\n        unfinished_index: List[int] = []\n        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):\n            req.output_ids.append(next_token_cpu[i])\n            req.check_finished()\n            if not req.finished():\n                unfinished_index.append(i)\n            req.spec_verify_ct += 1\n\n        if len(unfinished_index) < bs:\n            keep = torch.tensor(\n                unfinished_index, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device\n            )\n            si = batch.spec_info\n            if si.topk_p is not None:\n                si.topk_p = si.topk_p[keep]\n            if si.topk_index is not None:\n                si.topk_index = si.topk_index[keep]\n            if si.hidden_states is not None:\n                si.hidden_states = si.hidden_states[keep]\n            si.verified_id = si.verified_id[keep]\n            si.accept_length = si.accept_length[keep]\n            si.accept_length_cpu = [si.accept_length_cpu[i] for i in unfinished_index]\n\n        return GenerationBatchResult(\n            logits_output=target_result.logits_output,\n            next_token_ids=next_token_ids,\n            num_accepted_tokens=bs,\n            accept_length_per_req_cpu=[1] * bs,\n            can_run_cuda_graph=target_result.can_run_cuda_graph,\n        )"
```json
}
```

> AGENT

找到根因了。是我之前在 `scheduler.init_model_worker` 里 bump 了 `server_args.speculative_num_draft_tokens` 给 cuda graph capture 用，但这个值同时影响了 `memory_pool` 计算 `extra_max_context_len`：

```python
# model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py:332
extra_max_context_len = 4 + speculative_num_draft_tokens
```

bump dtn 7→13 → pool `max_context_len += 13` → `req_to_sparse_k1_token` dim 1 = **32768**。但 `minicpm_backend` 用的是 `model_config.context_len`（没加 extra）→ `metadata.k1.table` dim 1 = **32767**。

两边 mismatch 才差 1。

## 修

直接让 backend 从 pool 读 dim 1，而不是自己重新算（避免 extra 偏差）：

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minicpm_backend.py",
  "old_string": "        max_num_pages = (self.max_context_len + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size\n        max_k1_num_pages = (\n            (self.max_context_len - self.k1_kernel_size) // self.k1_kernel_stride\n            + 1\n            + self.page_size\n            - 1\n        ) // self.page_size\n        max_k2_num_pages = (\n            (self.max_context_len - self.k2_kernel_size) // self.k2_kernel_stride\n            + 1\n            + self.page_size\n            - 1\n        ) // self.page_size",
  "new_string": "        max_num_pages = (self.max_context_len + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size\n        # Use the actual dim-1 of the req_to_sparse_*_token pool tensors so\n        # capture buffers match what runtime hands us. The pool sizes itself\n        # to (model_config.context_len + extra_max_context_len) where extra\n        # = 4 + speculative_num_draft_tokens, but self.max_context_len here\n        # is the raw model_config.context_len — recomputing dims from\n        # max_context_len drifts off by extra/kernel_stride pages.\n        max_k1_num_pages = (\n            self.req_to_sparse_k1_token.shape[1] + self.page_size - 1\n        ) // self.page_size\n        max_k2_num_pages = (\n            self.req_to_sparse_k2_token.shape[1] + self.page_size - 1\n        ) // self.page_size"
}
```

修好了。改动一行（实际 6 行替换）：直接用 `req_to_sparse_k1_token.shape[1]` / `req_to_sparse_k2_token.shape[1]` 作为 dim 1 的来源，不再用 `(max_context_len - kernel_size) / kernel_stride + 1` 重算（避免 pool 多 alloc 的 extra context 偏移）。

> AGENT

找到了。看 `ForwardBatch.init_new` 行 576-580：

```python
elif (
    ret.spec_info is not None
    and getattr(ret.spec_info, "positions", None) is not None
):
    ret.positions = ret.spec_info.positions
```

**`spec_info.positions` 不为 None 时，会覆盖 forward_batch.positions。**

`forward_draft_extend_after_decode` 末尾通过 `prepare_extend_after_decode` 把 `spec_info.positions` 设成长度 = 上一步 bs。下一步 NO_SPEC 进来时 batch.reqs 数量可能变了（finished filter / retract），但 `spec_info.positions` 还是上次的旧 size → forward_batch.positions = 旧 size，但 forward_batch.batch_size = 新 size → mismatch。

## 修

NO_SPEC fast path 不需要 spec_info.positions，让 ForwardBatch.init_new 走默认 `clamp_position(batch.seq_lens)`：

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/speculative/eagle_worker.py",
  "old_string": "        # 2. Stash a synthetic \"verify accepted 1 token\" spec_info on the batch\n        #    so forward_draft_extend_after_decode() can consume it normally.\n        if not isinstance(batch.spec_info, EagleDraftInput):\n            batch.spec_info = EagleDraftInput()\n        batch.spec_info.verified_id = next_token_ids\n        batch.spec_info.hidden_states = last_hidden",
  "new_string": "        # 2. Stash a synthetic \"verify accepted 1 token\" spec_info on the batch\n        #    so forward_draft_extend_after_decode() can consume it normally.\n        if not isinstance(batch.spec_info, EagleDraftInput):\n            batch.spec_info = EagleDraftInput()\n        # Clear any stale spec_info.positions left over from a previous spec\n        # step's prepare_extend_after_decode. ForwardBatch.init_new copies\n        # spec_info.positions verbatim when set, but its length tracks last\n        # step's bs — if reqs changed (filter/retract/merge), this mismatches\n        # the current forward_batch.batch_size and crashes input_buffers.copy_.\n        # NO_SPEC doesn't need spec-supplied positions; clamp_position(seq_lens)\n        # is the right default for DECODE.\n        batch.spec_info.positions = None\n        batch.spec_info.verified_id = next_token_ids\n        batch.spec_info.hidden_states = last_hidden"
}
```

```
# EAGLE-3 speculative decoding server (current production config)
# - spec_steps=3, topk=2, dtn=7  (chain verify)
# - target: NVFP4 (GPTQ + FourOverSix), hybrid Marlin/CUTLASS decode @ threshold=48
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# =============================================================
# mini_bench.sh — 快速速度验证（全量 bench 的 ~25%）
#
# 用法:
#   bash bench/mini_bench.sh [API_BASE] [N_S1] [N_S8] [N_SMAX]
#
# 默认值:
#   API_BASE = http://127.0.0.1:30000
#   N_S1=3  N_S8=8  N_SMAX=16
#
# S8=8 恰好一个满批，能体现并发压力；Smax=16 覆盖长尾。
# 数据集嵌套关系: S1(8) ⊆ S8(24) ⊆ Smax(64)，每档样本唯一。
# 本脚本取各档前 N 条，保留与全量相同的长尾特性。
# =============================================================

API_BASE="${1:-http://127.0.0.1:30000}"
N_S1="${2:-0}"
N_S8="${3:-0}"
N_SMAX="${4:-64}"

BENCH_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
DATA_DIR="${BENCH_DIR}/data"
TOOLKIT_BENCH="${BENCH_DIR}/../toolkit/bench_serving.sh"

echo "=========================================================="
echo "  mini_bench  S1=${N_S1}  S8=${N_S8}  Smax=${N_SMAX}"
echo "  API: ${API_BASE}"
echo "=========================================================="

# 分层抽样到 /tmp（按 prompt_tokens 分布均匀取样，避免前段全是短请求）
S1_MINI="/tmp/mini_s1.jsonl"
S8_MINI="/tmp/mini_s8.jsonl"
SMAX_MINI="/tmp/mini_smax.jsonl"

python3 - <<PY
import json, random

SEED = 42
```

OOM 根因找到。我在 `init_model_worker` bump 了 `server_args.speculative_num_draft_tokens`（10→13）和 `speculative_num_steps`（3→4）给 cuda graph capture 用，但**这两个值之后被 scheduler 拿去算 `decode_mem_cache_buf_multiplier`**（line 754），导致预留过大、scheduler 的 prefill budget 估算错位 → prefill alloc fail → 直接崩溃（不是 retract）。

修：cuda graph capture 完后立即还原 `server_args` 到 CLI 原值。

这一轮一共做了 5 个修复（都没动服务器，只改了源码 + 测试启动）：

## 1. 撤回 #3 NO_SPEC lazy catch-up
设计有 cache 生命周期问题（_flush 时 `out_cache_loc is None`），回到稳定路径：每步走 `forward_draft_extend_after_decode` 同步 draft KV。

## 2. NO_SPEC `capture_hidden_mode` LAST → FULL
`eagle_worker.py:_forward_no_spec`。target cuda_graph_runner 的 `self.capture_hidden_mode` 在 capture 末尾固定为 FULL（来自 EagleVerifyInput 默认）；NO_SPEC 用 LAST 不匹配 → can_run False → eager fallback (`cuda graph: False`)。改 FULL 后命中 graph，且 DECODE 模式下 FULL 等价 LAST。

## 3. minicpm `k1.table` dim 1 mismatch (32767 vs 32768)
`minicpm_backend.py:init_cuda_graph_state`。原来按 `(max_context_len - kernel_size)/kernel_stride+1` 重算 `max_k1_num_pages`，但 memory_pool 用 `model_config.context_len + extra_max_context_len`（含 spec dtn），两边 dim 1 偏移一个。改成直接读 `self.req_to_sparse_k1_token.shape[1]` 取 pool 实际 dim。

## 4. NO_SPEC `spec_info.positions` 残留 → input_buffers crash
`eagle_worker.py:_forward_no_spec`。上一步 `prepare_extend_after_decode` 把 `spec_info.positions` 设成那个 step 的 bs 大小；下一步 NO_SPEC 时 batch.reqs 数变了（filter/retract/merge），但 positions 还是旧 size，`ForwardBatch.init_new` 直接用它覆盖 → input_buffers `copy_` 形状不一致。修：进 `prepare_for_decode` 之前清空 `batch.spec_info.positions`。

## 5. OOM crash on prefill —— bump `speculative_num_draft_tokens` / `num_steps` 没还原
`scheduler.py:init_model_worker`。dynamic mode 给 cuda graph capture bump dtn 10→13、steps 3→4，但**没还原**，scheduler 后续在 `__init__` 里用这两个值算 `decode_mem_cache_buf_multiplier`（决定 prefill cache 预留），多估了 ~30% → `_get_new_batch_prefill_raw` 调度的 chunk 实际 alloc 不下 → 直接 OOM 崩溃（不是 retract）。修：cuda graph capture 完立刻还原 server_args 到 CLI 原值；`cuda_graph_runner` 已缓存 `num_tokens_per_bs` 为 max，不受还原影响。

`intermediate_ssm_state_cache` 占 **39.61 GB**，shape 是 `[num_layers, max_size+1, speculative_num_draft_tokens, HV, K, V]`（memory_pool.py:218）。

dynamic mode 我把 `server_args.speculative_num_draft_tokens` bump 到 13（D7_DTN）给 cuda graph capture 用，**但这个 server_args 同时被 mamba pool 在 init_kv_cache_pool 时读到**，pool 按 13 alloc。

| | mamba intermediate_ssm | KV pool | 可并发 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 不开 dynamic（dtn=10） | 39.61 × 10/13 ≈ 30.5 GB | 多约 9 GB → 1.74M token | ~64 |
| 开 dynamic（dtn=13） | 39.61 GB | 1.12M token | ~40 |

**bump dtn 给 cuda graph capture，意外吃掉了 9 GB mamba 显存**。我之前的还原修复只在 capture **之后**生效（解决 OOM），但 mamba pool **在 capture 之前**就 alloc 了，已经按 13 alloc 完了，还原也救不回来。

## 三条路

**A.** 让 mamba pool 按 CLI dtn (10) alloc，cuda graph 按 max dtn (13) capture
   - 需要在 model_runner 流程中区分 "memory_pool alloc 阶段" 和 "cuda graph capture 阶段" 分别注入不同 dtn
   - 改动面：scheduler bump 时机 + 可能 hack model_runner

**B.** 限制 `D7_DTN ≤ D5_DTN`（最大就是 D5_DTN）
   - `EAGLE_D7_DTN=7 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=3 EAGLE_D7_TOPK=2`（跟 D5 一样）
   - 失去 D7 长 chain 优势 = 失去 dynamic 拉高 S1 的核心动机

**C.** 接受现状（40 并发）
   - 开 dynamic 是为 S1 拉高吞吐；S1 全程 bs=1，KV pool 用不满；并发 40 vs 64 不影响 S1 throughput
   - 影响 Smax 测试，但比赛 Smax 也未必能 64 并发跑（KV pool 容量限制）

## "restored speculative_num_draft_tokens 13 -> 10 (post-capture)" 是什么意思

这是我刚才加的修复。流程是：

```
[scheduler.init_model_worker]
  ↓ bump dtn 10→13 (因为 cuda graph 要按 max dtn capture buffer)
[scheduler.init_tp_model_worker]
  ↓ ModelRunner.__init__
    ↓ init_memory_pool()  ← 读 dtn=13，mamba pool 按 13 alloc (39.61GB)  ← ⚠️ 浪费源头
    ↓ init_device_graphs() ← 按 dtn=13 capture cuda graphs ✓ 这是必需的
[scheduler.init_model_worker 末尾]
  ↓ restore dtn 13→10  ← 这条 log
[scheduler.__init__ 后续]
  ↓ decode_mem_cache_buf_multiplier 用 dtn=10 算 budget ✓ 不再 OOM
```

restore 是为了避免 scheduler 后续算 prefill budget 时把 dtn=13 当稳态值，估算 30% 偏多 → OOM crash。这个 fix 解了 OOM 但**没解 mamba 浪费**——因为 mamba pool 在 restore 之前就 alloc 完了。

---

## 详细调查结果

### Mamba 浪费的根因（精确定位）

**`model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py:381`**:
```python
self.req_to_token_pool = MiniCPMHybridReqToTokenPool(
    ...
    speculative_num_draft_tokens=self.server_args.speculative_num_draft_tokens,  # = 13 (bumped)
)
```

**`memory_pool.py:218-225`**:
```python
intermediate_ssm_state_cache = torch.zeros(
    (num_layers, size+1, speculative_num_draft_tokens, HV, K, V),  # 含 dtn 维度
    dtype=fp32,
)
```

`(64+1) * 13 * 24层 * H * K * V * 4byte = 39.61GB`，dtn=10 就是 30.47GB。差 9 GB。

### ModelRunner init 流程
```
__init__ →
  init_memory_pool()     ← mamba 按 server_args.dtn alloc  ⚠️ 浪费源头
  init_attention_backend()
  init_device_graphs()   ← cuda graph 按 server_args.dtn capture
```

两步在同一个调用栈，无法外部插 hook。

### 关键约束（卡住"最优"的物理事实）

D7 mode 实际 forward 时，每个 req 用 `D7_dtn` 个 mamba slot（intermediate_ssm 写 13 个槽位）。mamba pool 是 **`(max_size, dtn) 矩形`** 分配，不能让某个 req 占 13、其他 req 占 7。

→ mamba pool dtn 必须 ≥ `max(D5_dtn, D7_dtn)` —— 否则 D7 forward 写越界。

→ **物理上**：要 D7_dtn=13，mamba pool 必须按 13 alloc。9 GB 浪费**不可避免**，除非改 memory_pool 结构（让 D7 那 1 个 req 单独多占 6 slot，其他 63 个按 7 slot）。

## 三个方案

### 方案 1（真·最优 / 高工程量）改 memory_pool 非矩形分配
让 `intermediate_ssm` 不是 `(max_size, max_dtn)` 矩形，而是 `(max_size, D5_dtn) + (1, D7_dtn - D5_dtn)` 拼接。runtime 时 D7 bs=1 那个 req 走"补丁区"，其他走主区。
- **节省**：~9 GB（恢复 64 并发）
- **改动**：`memory_pool.py` 数据结构 + `hybrid_linear_attn_backend` 的 mamba state 索引逻辑 + spec mode 切换时 D7 req 选取
- **工程量**：~300 行 + 大量调试，触碰 sglang 核心 mamba 路径
- **风险**：可能破坏 mamba state 一致性，bug 隐患高

### 方案 2（务实 - 推荐）约束 `D7_DTN ≤ D5_DTN`，单靠 mars theta 拉高 S1
让 D7 = D5 dtn 但 mars_theta 更激进。`max_dtn = D5_dtn = 7`，bump 不再发生。
- **节省**：~9 GB（恢复 64 并发）
- **失去**：D7 长 chain 优势
- **保留**：D7 用更激进 mars_theta（0.5 vs D5 的 0.85） — S1 拉高的核心机制仍在
- **改动**：用户改 env `EAGLE_D7_TOPK=2 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=2 EAGLE_D7_DTN=5` 或 `=3/2/7`（与 D5 一致）；代码无改动
- **真实性**：mars_theta 0.85→0.5 把"接受 top2 token"门槛从严苛压到极宽，accept rate 已经飙了；再叠加 chain 深度 7→13 边际效益可能不到 5-10%，**不值 9 GB**

### 方案 3（妥协）接受 dynamic mode 下 ~40 并发
- S1 测试 (bs=1) 不受影响 —— mamba pool 浪费不挤压 bs=1
- Smax 测试受影响，但 SOAR 评分主要看 S1 + S8 throughput，Smax 权重一般小
- 改动：无

## 推荐路径

**方案 2** —— 现在就让你试，零代码改动：
```bash
EAGLE_D5_TOPK=3 EAGLE_D5_STEPS=2 EAGLE_D5_DTN=7 \
EAGLE_D7_TOPK=3 EAGLE_D7_STEPS=2 EAGLE_D7_DTN=7 \
EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA=0.5 EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA=0.85 \
bash eval/start_eagle.sh
```

DTN 一致 → max_dtn=7=CLI dtn，bump 是 no-op，mamba pool 30.5 GB 而不是 39.6 GB，可并发恢复 64。你现在用 D7_DTN=13 的真正提升大概是 5-10%；这 9 GB 把 KV pool 给的 60% 容量加回来更值。

如果实测发现 D7 长 chain 真的有非线性提升（>15%），再投资方案 1。

调查清楚了。**最优方案**：拆分 `intermediate_ssm_state_cache` 为两个独立 buffer——一个专门服 D5（spec_state_size 大、dtn 小），一个专门服 D7（spec_state_size 小到只 1、dtn 大）。这能从根上消除浪费。

## 计算

| 配置 | shape | cells |
|---|---|---|
| 当前（max_dtn=13 矩形） | 24 × 65 × **13** | 20,280 |
| 拆分后 D5 主区 | 24 × 65 × **7** | 10,920 |
| 拆分后 D7 补丁 | 24 × **2** × 13 | 624 |
| 拆分总计 | | 11,544 |

**省 43%**：39.61 GB → 22.55 GB，**释放 17 GB 给 KV pool**。

KV pool 多 17 GB / 8KB per token = +2.1M token。原 1.12M → 3.22M。64 reqs × avg 27.7K = 1.77M ✓ 64 并发完全 fits。

## 关键观察

`hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py:2062`:
```python
ht_buf = intermediate_ssm[cache_idx, :batch_size, :draft_token_num]
```

D7 mode 时 `batch_size=1, draft_token_num=13` → 只用 1 × 13 = 13 个槽位。
D5 mode 时 `batch_size ≤ 30, draft_token_num=7` → 最多 30 × 7 = 210 槽位。

**dynamic spec mode 下 D5 与 D7 的 bs 范围互不重叠**（D5 ∈ [2..30], D7 = 1）。任意 verify call 只用其中一组。两个 buffer 独立 alloc → runtime dispatch 拿对应 buffer → 零浪费。

## 实施清单（动手）

1. `memory_pool.py:Mamba2Cache` — `SpeculativeState` 加 `intermediate_ssm_d5` / `intermediate_ssm_d7` 字段，alloc 两份
2. `MiniCPMHybridReqToTokenPool.__init__` — 接收 `(d5_dtn, d7_dtn, d5_max_bs)` 参数
3. `model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.init_memory_pool` — 读 env 传给 pool
4. `hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py:forward` — 按 `draft_token_num` dispatch 选 buffer
5. `init_cuda_graph_state` 里的 `_cg_fused_o_buf` / `_cg_fused_ht_buf` 也要分两份（否则 D7 graph 写到 D5 size buffer 越界）

Each pair\n        # allocates a separate intermediate_ssm/_conv_window patch buffer.\n        # Used by dynamic spec mode to alloc a small (1+1, D7_dtn) buffer for\n        # bs=1 D7 verify alongside the main (size+1, D5_dtn) buffer.\n        extra_intermediate_patches: Optional[List[Tuple[int, int]]] = None,\n    ):"
```json
}
```

## 实施总结（4 个文件）

### 1. `memory_pool.py`
- `get_tensor_size_bytes` 支持 dict / None
- `MambaPool.SpeculativeState` 新增 `intermediate_ssm_patches: Dict[int, Tensor]` 和 `intermediate_conv_window_patches`
- `MambaPool.__init__` 接受 `extra_intermediate_patches: List[(patch_size, patch_dtn)]`，按列表 alloc 独立 patch buffer
- `State.at_layer_idx` 切片时正确处理 dict 字段
- 新参数贯穿 `HybridReqToTokenPool` / `MiniCPMHybridReqToTokenPool`

### 2. `model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py`
- `init_memory_pool` 读 `EAGLE_DYNAMIC_MODE` / `EAGLE_D5_DTN` / `EAGLE_D7_DTN` / `EAGLE_D7_BS` env
- dynamic mode + D7_DTN > D5_DTN 时：主 buffer dtn = D5_DTN，附加 patch (size=D7_BS=1, dtn=D7_DTN)

### 3. `hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py` 三个 dispatch 点
- `SimpleGLAAttnBackend.forward` (line 2050) — verify 时按 `draft_token_num` 选 buffer
- `forward_extend` 的 `is_target_verify` 分支 (line 1302) — 同样 dispatch
- `update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify` — 接受新参 `draft_token_num`，scatter 时按 dtn 选源

### 4. `eagle_worker.py`
- 调用 `update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify` 时传 `draft_token_num=batch.spec_info.draft_token_num`

## 期望效果

| 配置 | intermediate_ssm | KV pool | 64 并发 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 当前 D7_DTN=13 矩形 | 39.61 GB | 1.12M token | ❌ |
| 新方案 D5+patch | 21.32 (D5主) + 1.22 (D7补) = **22.54 GB** | +17 GB → ~3.25M token | ✅ |

S1 全程 D7 (bs=1) → 走 patch buffer dtn=13，长 chain 优势保留。
D5 范围 [2..30] → 走主 buffer dtn=7，正常工作。
NO_SPEC 不读 intermediate buffer。

你测完告诉我结果。如果 boot log 显示 `intermediate_ssm_state_cache size: 21.32GB + intermediate_ssm patches (dtns=[13]): 1.22GB` 和 KV pool tokens > 3M 就说明生效。

hysteresis：进了 NO_SPEC 后要 bs ≤ **16** 才退回 D5（避免在 18/19 边界抖动重复 capture）。

## 顺带的额外节省机会

我之前给 mamba 主 buffer 留的是 `spec_state_size = max_num_reqs = 64`。但 D5 实际最多 bs=18，主 buffer 也只用前 18 行。如果**把 spec_state_size 设成 enter_no_spec_bs**（=19），主 buffer 还能再瘦：

| | 现在 (size=64) | 收紧 (size=19) | 节省 |
|---|---|---|---|
| D5 主 buffer (24, n+1, 7, ...) | ~21.3 GB | ~6.6 GB | ~15 GB |

加上之前的 D7 patch 1.22 GB，总 mamba intermediate 从 39.6 GB 砍到 ~7.8 GB，KV pool 进一步多 14-15 GB。

要把这一刀也切了吗？只需要在 `model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py` 里把 `mamba_spec_state_size` 在 dynamic mode 下设成 `enter_no_spec_bs - 1`，约 10 行改动。

> DEVELOPER

这些居然是硬编码的么？

> AGENT

不算严格"硬编码"——参数本身是可配的，但调用方默认传 `max_num_reqs`，等价于"为所有 req 全部预留 spec verify 的中间状态"。

`model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py:379`:
```python
self.req_to_token_pool = MiniCPMHybridReqToTokenPool(
    size=max_num_reqs,
    ...
    mamba_size=self.server_args.max_mamba_cache_size,   # = max_num_reqs (=64)
    mamba_spec_state_size=max_num_reqs,                 # ← 这里
    speculative_num_draft_tokens=...,
)
```

`mamba_spec_state_size` 决定 `intermediate_ssm` 第二维（=spec verify 时同时缓存中间状态的 req 数上限）。

sglang 原版假设是合理的："spec mode 是全局开关，任何 req 都可能跑 verify"。**所以保险起见预留 max_num_reqs 个 slot**。

但 **dynamic spec mode 打破了这个假设**：
- `bs ≥ enter_no_spec_bs` 时**所有 req 都走 NO_SPEC**，不跑 verify，intermediate_ssm 不被读写
- `bs < enter_no_spec_bs` 时才走 D5/D7，**最多** enter_no_spec_bs - 1 个 req 同时跑 verify
- 所以 `spec_state_size = enter_no_spec_bs - 1` 就够了，剩下 `max_num_reqs - enter_no_spec_bs + 1` 个 slot 是冷的

这是 dynamic mode 的"额外信息"，sglang 不知道，所以没自动收紧。

要切这刀，加 ~10 行：在我 dynamic 检测分支里，`mamba_spec_state_size = enter_no_spec_bs - 1`（保守 + 1 = enter_no_spec_bs 也可以）。

要做吗？预期效果：

```
当前主 buffer (24, 65, 7, ...) ≈ 21.3 GB
收紧后    (24, 19, 7, ...) ≈  6.6 GB     省 15 GB
+ D7 patch (24, 2, 13, ...) ≈ 1.2 GB
总 mamba intermediate: 7.8 GB（vs 原版 39.6 GB，节省 80%）
```

KV pool 多 ~30 GB → tokens > 5M → 64 reqs 即使 avg 80K prompt 也能 fit。

## 改动说明

`model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py:init_memory_pool` 在 dynamic spec mode 分支里：

```python
main_spec_state_size = max_num_reqs                      # 默认 64
if dynamic enabled and enter_no_spec_bs > 0:
    main_spec_state_size = min(max_num_reqs, enter_no_spec_bs - 1)
```

`enter_no_spec_bs - 1` 因为 selector 是 `bs >= enter_no_spec_bs → NO_SPEC`，spec mode 实际能跑的最大 bs = enter_no_spec_bs - 1。`min(max_num_reqs, ...)` 兜底（如果用户把 enter_no_spec_bs 设得比 max_num_reqs 还大就退回原值，不溢出）。

`max(.., 1)` 保险（避免 0）。

## 当前配置下的预算

```
EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS=19  → main_spec_state_size = 18
EAGLE_D7_BS=1        → patch_state_size = 1
EAGLE_D5_DTN=7
EAGLE_D7_DTN=13
max_running_requests=36（CLAUDE.md 之前说 64，实际 start_eagle.sh 现在是 36）
```

| 原版（max_num_reqs=36, dtn=13 矩形） | (24, 37, 13, 32, 128, 128) × fp32 | ~22.4 GB |

| D7 patch | (24, 2, 13, ...) | ~1.2 GB |

省 **15 GB**（原 22.4 GB 基础上）。如果 max_running_requests 是 64 则原版 ~39.6 GB，节省 32 GB。

回退完成（`06ed8e0`）。

## 现在的状态（commit chain）

```
06ed8e0 revert: 撤回 mamba pool 拆分        ← 最新
e291467 fix: KV pool reclaim + 各种 fix   ← 保留（除 mamba 拆分）
20cc58a perf: hot path #1+#2
b7a839e feat: dynamic spec mode
```

## 撤回的（mamba 拆分相关）

- `intermediate_ssm` D5 主 + D7 patch 分离
- `spec_state_size` 收紧 (max_num_reqs → enter_no_spec_bs - 1)
- `start_eagle.sh` enter_no_spec_bs 19/16 → 31/28
- 4 个文件的 dispatch 逻辑

## 保留的（独立有效的修复）

- scheduler bump/restore（解 OOM）
- NO_SPEC FULL hidden + clear stale positions
- minicpm `k1.table` dim from pool（解 32767 vs 32768）
- per-mode MARS theta（`EAGLE_D{5,7}_MARS_THETA`）
- 撤回 #3 lazy + 不 restore topk + recompile_limit=32
- start_eagle.sh 其他配置（DYNAMIC_MODE=1, D5/D7 dtn 等）

`intermediate_ssm` 回到原版 `(max_size+1, max_dtn)` 矩形，浪费回来了，但稳定。

> AGENT

仔细 review 完，找到 **2 个显著的显示 bug**，最严重的会让 NO_SPEC 期间的 throughput 显示翻倍。

## Bug A — NO_SPEC `num_accepted_tokens` 语义错误（影响 3 个指标）

`eagle_worker.py:_forward_no_spec` 返回：
```python
num_accepted_tokens=bs,
accept_length_per_req_cpu=[1] * bs,
```

但**正常 spec 路径下** `num_accepted_tokens` 的语义是 **"接受的 draft tokens 数（不含 user_4813494d）"**：
```python
# scheduler_output_processor_mixin.py:299
result.num_accepted_tokens = sum(accept_lens) - len(batch.reqs)  # = sum(draft accepted)
```

NO_SPEC 路径**没有 draft**，应该返回 `num_accepted_tokens=0`。

### 后果三连击

下游处理：
```python
# scheduler_output_processor_mixin.py:378
self.num_generated_tokens += len(batch.reqs)            # +bs (user_4813494d)
# 然后 update_spec_metrics:
self.num_generated_tokens += num_accepted_tokens         # +bs (错！应+0)
self.spec_num_accepted_tokens += num_accepted_tokens + bs  # +2bs (错！应+bs)
self.spec_num_forward_ct += bs
```

**NO_SPEC 期间显示**：

| 指标 | 显示值 | 实际值 | 错因 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gen throughput (token/s)` | **2× 真实值** | 1× | num_generated_tokens 多加 bs |
| `accept len` | **2.00** 固定 | 1.00 | spec_num_accepted_tokens (2bs) / spec_num_forward_ct (bs) = 2 |
| `accept rate` | **0.08-0.11** | 0 | pure_draft_accepted = 2bs - bs = bs > 0（应该=0） |

你之前说 "accept rate: 0.08, gen throughput 2843" —— 那个 2843 实际只有 ~1421，accept rate 实际 0。这就是用户一直困惑 "NO_SPEC 怎么还有 accept rate" 的原因。

### 修复（一行）

`_forward_no_spec` 末尾：
```python
return GenerationBatchResult(
    ...
    num_accepted_tokens=0,                 # 不是 bs
    accept_length_per_req_cpu=[0] * bs,    # 不是 [1]*bs
    ...
)
```

## Bug B — `spec_accept_rate` 分母用静态 `server_args.speculative_num_draft_tokens`

`scheduler_metrics_mixin.py:345-356`:
```python
num_draft_tokens = self.server_args.speculative_num_draft_tokens  # = CLI dtn (静态)
total_draft_tokens = self.spec_num_forward_ct * (num_draft_tokens - 1)
spec_accept_rate = pure_draft_accepted / total_draft_tokens
```

Dynamic mode 下实际 dtn 因 D5/D7 不同：
- D5 step：max draft = `D5_dtn - 1 = 6`，分母按 `9` 算 → **显示偏低 33%**
- D7 step：max draft = `D7_dtn - 1 = 12`，分母按 `9` 算 → **显示偏高 33%**
- NO_SPEC step：被累加到 `forward_ct` 但实际没 draft → 分母虚高

混合 D5+D7+NO_SPEC 的 step 区间，这个比例完全是 garbage 数字。

### 修复

`update_spec_metrics` 加一个 `num_draft_tokens` 参数（按当前 step 实际 dtn 传），累加 `total_draft_tokens` 而不是用静态值再乘。

```python
# 现状
def update_spec_metrics(self, bs, num_accepted_tokens):
    self.spec_num_accepted_tokens += num_accepted_tokens + bs
    self.spec_num_forward_ct += bs

# 改成
def update_spec_metrics(self, bs, num_accepted_tokens, num_draft_tokens=0):
    self.spec_num_accepted_tokens += num_accepted_tokens + bs
    self.spec_num_forward_ct += bs
    self.spec_total_draft_tokens += bs * num_draft_tokens   # 实际 step 的 dtn
```

打 log 时 `accept_rate = pure_draft_accepted / spec_total_draft_tokens`，分母与每步实际匹配。

`num_draft_tokens` 可以从 worker 返回的 `result.num_draft_tokens` 字段（D5=6 / D7=12 / NO_SPEC=0），eagle_worker 已经知道当前 mode 的值。

---

**优先级**：A 必修（throughput 显示 2×，会误导调优）。B 顺便修（accept rate 在 mode 切换时才需要精确，trade-off 决策的关键参考）。

- 平台跑出来是**静态 spec**（topk=2, steps=3, dtn=7），没有 D7 长 chain、没有 NO_SPEC fallback
- → 你这一周做的所有 dynamic mode + per-mode mars theta + cuda graph 修复**都不会生效**

**2. draft model 路径不匹配 + 内容是旧版**
- `prepare_env.sh`: `data/eagle_draft`（v2，aux layers `[1, 10, 22]`，434 MB）
- `start_eagle.sh`: `eagle/sglang_model_v3`（v3，aux layers `[4, 9, 24]`，507 MB）

- `SGLANG_MINICPM_FILL_COMPRESS_BUFFERS=0`

EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS="${EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS:-31}" \
EAGLE_NO_SPEC_LEAVE_BS="${EAGLE_NO_SPEC_LEAVE_BS:-28}" \ 这两个 bs 怎么理解

> AGENT

这两个是**进入 NO_SPEC 的滞后阈值（hysteresis）**，避免在 bs 边界抖动时反复切换 mode。

## 含义

```
EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS=31         ← 进入阈值
EAGLE_NO_SPEC_LEAVE_BS=28   ← 离开阈值
```

- **从 D5/D7 进 NO_SPEC**：要求 `bs ≥ 31`
- **从 NO_SPEC 退回 D5/D7**：要求 `bs ≤ 28`

中间 `bs ∈ [29, 30]` 是**滞后区**：当前是什么 mode 就保持什么 mode，bs 在 29-30 之间游走时**不会切换**。

## 为什么要滞后

如果只用一个阈值（比如 30）：
- bs=30 → NO_SPEC
- 一个 req 完成 → bs=29 → 切回 D5（重新 setup spec）
- 新 req 进来 → bs=30 → 又切 NO_SPEC
- 抖动 → 反复 spec 切换 → 性能崩

加 hysteresis：
- bs=30 在 NO_SPEC 时，要降到 28 才切回 D5
- 切回 D5 后，要升到 31 才切 NO_SPEC
- 中间至少有 3 步缓冲，避免 1-req 波动触发切换

## selector 完整行为图

```
                       prev = D5            prev = D7            prev = NO_SPEC
bs ≥ 31                NO_SPEC              NO_SPEC              NO_SPEC (hold)
bs ∈ [29, 30]          D5 (hold)            D5                   NO_SPEC (hold)
bs ∈ [4, 28]           D5 (hold)            D5                   D5 (转出)
bs ∈ [2, 3]            D5                   D5                   D5
bs == 1                D7                   D7 (hold)            D7
```

代码在 `spec_mode.py:137-166`，关键 4 行：

```python
prev = self.current
if prev == NO_SPEC:
    if bs <= leave_no_spec_bs:        # bs ≤ 28 → 出 NO_SPEC
        new = D7 if bs <= enter_d7_bs else D5
    else:
        new = NO_SPEC                  # 29/30 还 hold
elif prev in (D5, D7):
    if bs >= enter_no_spec_bs:        # bs ≥ 31 → 进 NO_SPEC
        new = NO_SPEC
    ...
```

## 调这俩参数对什么有影响

- `EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS` 调小（比如 19）→ 更早放弃 spec → 高 bs 更早走纯 target decode → 低吞吐 / 高质量更不重要
- `EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS` 调大（比如 64）→ 永不进 NO_SPEC → 高 bs 也跑 spec verify（dtn 个 token 的 attention 全跑）→ 显存压力 + verify 开销变重
- 滞后窗口 `enter - leave = 3` 是经验值。窗口太窄抖动；太宽切换迟钝（一直 NO_SPEC 拉低小 bs 收益）

默认 31/28 适合 max_running_requests=36 的场景：能让 bs ∈ [4, 30] 全部跑 D5（绝大多数时间），bs=31..36 才走 NO_SPEC 释放 spec verify 开销。

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **NO_SPEC num_accepted_tokens=bs bug** (display errors):
     - accept_len showed 2.00 (actual 1.00), accept_rate 0.08-0.11 (actual 0), throughput 2× real
     - user_4813494d: _forward_no_spec returned num_accepted_tokens=bs; update_spec_metrics added bs+bs=2bs
     - Fix: return 0 for num_accepted_tokens and [0]*bs for accept_length_per_req_cpu; pass max_draft_per_req=0
   
   - **cuda graph: False in NO_SPEC**:
     - capture_hidden_mode=LAST didn't match target cuda graph runner's FULL (from EagleVerifyInput default)
     - Fix: use CaptureHiddenMode.FULL in _forward_no_spec target forward call

   - **NO_SPEC input_buffers positions crash (39 vs 40)**:
     - spec_info.positions left stale from prior step's prepare_extend_after_decode
     - Fix: clear spec_info.positions=None before prepare_for_decode

   - **minicpm k1.table 32767 vs 32768**:
     - init_cuda_graph_state recomputed from max_context_len but pool used context_len+extra_max_context_len
     - Fix: use self.req_to_sparse_k1_token.shape[1] directly

   - **Scheduler OOM prefill crash**:
     - bump dtn for cuda graph capture was not restored; decode_mem_cache_buf_multiplier used inflated dtn
     - Fix: restore server_args after init_tp_model_worker + init_draft_worker

   - **spec_info.positions shape mismatch with batch size change**:
     - merge_batch hidden_states: NO_SPEC had 12288-dim hidden vs prefill 4096-dim
     - Fix: placeholder zeros(bs, draft_hidden_size) then forward_draft_extend_after_decode resets to 4096

   - **Mamba pool split reverted** per user request ("回到这个修改之前 别的不动"):
     - memory_pool.py and model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py reverted to HEAD~1
     - hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py dispatch hunks reverted manually
     - eagle_worker.py draft_token_num param removed

5. Problem Solving:
   - Per-mode MARS theta: module-level eagle_info._MARS_THETA written on every mode switch in _apply_spec_config
   - Dynamic recompile_limit=32: select_top_k_tokens @torch.compile specializes per (i, hidden_states None, dtn, topk) — D5+D7+NO_SPEC across capture_bs blows past default 8
   - accept_rate denominator accuracy: accumulated spec_total_draft_capacity per step avoids static dtn being wrong when D5(dtn=7) and D7(dtn=13) alternate
   - Packaging: v3 model + complete env alignment ensures platform gets same behavior as local eval

```
commit e29146778e811279c42d21b671dcd6fb6bc843f4
Author: SOAR User <[REDACTED]>
Date:   Tue Apr 28 08:47:26 2026 +0000

    fix(eagle/dynamic): KV pool reclaim, per-mode mars theta, crash fixes
    
    Dynamic spec mode landed but had four blockers under real load:
    "cuda graph: False" on NO_SPEC, OOM crash on prefill, capture-time
    buffer mismatch (32767 vs 32768), and ~9 GB of mamba pool reserved
    for D7 dtn that bs=1 D7 never uses. This commit fixes all four and
    adds per-mode MARS theta for S1 boost.
    
    — mamba pool: split intermediate_ssm into main + dtn patches —
    intermediate_ssm was sized (max_size+1, max_dtn) — a rectangular
    worst-case reservation. Under dynamic mode D7 only runs at bs=1,
    so 63/64 of the (·, D7_dtn) slots are dead. Fix: main buffer at
    D5_dtn × max_size, plus a patch dict keyed by dtn (e.g. D7 at 1+1
    slots × D7_dtn). Backend dispatches by spec_info.draft_token_num.
    Also tighten spec_state_size from max_num_reqs to enter_no_spec_bs-1
    since bs above that runs NO_SPEC (no verify, no intermediate_ssm).
    
    At max_running_requests=36, D5_DTN=7, D7_DTN=13, NO_SPEC_BS=19:
    intermediate_ssm 22.4 GB → 7.45 GB (6.23 main + 1.22 patch).
    Released ~15 GB rolls into KV pool: 1.12M → 3.53M tokens.
    
    — scheduler: bump dtn/steps for capture, restore for budget —
    init_model_worker bumped server_args.{dtn,num_steps} to max(D5,D7)
    so cuda graph capture covers both modes, but didn't restore.
    decode_mem_cache_buf_multiplier (computed downstream in __init__)
    read the bumped values, over-estimated prefill cache reservation,
    and _get_new_batch_prefill_raw scheduled chunks alloc_for_extend
    couldn't satisfy → hard OOM crash, not retract. Restore to CLI
    values right after init_tp_model_worker; cuda_graph_runner has
    already cached num_tokens_per_bs from the bumped value.
    
    — NO_SPEC fast path: FULL hidden + clear stale positions —
    Two regressions on transitions into NO_SPEC:
    * capture_hidden_mode=LAST never matched the captured DECODE graph
      (target's runner ends with FULL from EagleVerifyInput default),
      so can_run() returned False and fell back to eager — the "cuda
      graph: False" we observed. Switch to FULL; under DECODE forward
      mode FULL collapses to LAST anyway (1 token/req).
    * batch.spec_info.positions left over from prior step's
      prepare_extend_after_decode is sized to the old bs.
      ForwardBatch.init_new copies it verbatim, so a bs change between
      steps (filter/retract/merge) crashes input_buffers.copy_. Reset
      spec_info.positions=None before prepare_for_decode.
    
    — minicpm_backend: k1/k2 table dim from pool tensor —
    init_cuda_graph_state recomputed max_k{1,2}_num_pages from
    self.max_context_len = model_config.context_len, but the pool was
    sized at context_len + extra_max_context_len (extra includes
    speculative_num_draft_tokens). Off-by-one when extra > 0:
    metadata buffer 32767 vs pool tensor 32768. Read dim-1 directly
    from req_to_sparse_k{1,2}_token.shape[1].
    
    — per-mode MARS theta —
    EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA / EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA env (-1 = inherit global).
    _apply_spec_config writes eagle_info._MARS_THETA on each mode
    switch. Lets D7 (bs=1, S1) run a more aggressive theta (e.g. 0.5)
    without affecting D5 quality.
    
    — misc —
```

```
Author: SOAR User <[REDACTED]>
Date:   Tue Apr 28 05:42:16 2026 +0000

    perf(eagle/dynamic): kill three hot-path wastes in spec decode
    
    Three independent fixes on the spec-decode hot path. Each is a
    strict improvement (helps both EAGLE_DYNAMIC_MODE=0 and =1), no
    behavioural change beyond removing redundant work.
    
    #1 minicpm_backend: stop rebuilding verify_qo_indptr per step
      Replay was running torch.arange + copy_ to rewrite the qo_indptr
      buffer every TARGET_VERIFY step (8 standard-attn layers share one
      metadata, so 1 GPU kernel + alloc per step). Pre-build a per-dtn
      bank of indptr buffers in init_cuda_graph_state and just pick the
      matching one — zero hot-path arange / copy_. Same change in
      capture for symmetry.
    
    #2 cuda_graph_runner: collapse double _get_graph_key in replay
      replay_prepare and replay each called _get_graph_key, which does
      attribute chain access + f-string + dict lookup. Cache the graph
      kind ("default" / "decode" / "d5") on self in replay_prepare;
      replay rebuilds the key from self.bs + cached kind. Affects every
      cuda graph replay path (decode, medusa, EAGLE static, EAGLE dynamic).
    
    #3 eagle_worker: lazy draft KV catch-up across NO_SPEC runs
      NO_SPEC was paying a [REDACTED] per
      step purely to keep draft KV in sync — but draft KV is never read
      while NO_SPEC stays active, so each of those prefills was waste
      (estimated 0.3-1ms/step at bs=58). Now NO_SPEC parks (token, last
      hidden) on self._no_spec_pending keyed by req.rid; the first
      MARS_D5/D7 step after NO_SPEC ends triggers _flush_no_spec_pending,
      which builds one multi-token DRAFT_EXTEND covering all accumulated
      tokens. Filter / merge are handled implicitly by keying on rid.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit b7a839e76e0ebdb7fd4229eff0f465001b209de2
Author: SOAR User <[REDACTED]>
Date:   Tue Apr 28 05:25:47 2026 +0000

    feat(eagle): dynamic spec mode (NO_SPEC / D5 / D7) by running batch size
    
    Adds env-driven runtime mode switching for EAGLE-3 speculative decoding:
    - bs >= EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS (default 31): skip draft/verify, target direct decode
    - bs <= EAGLE_D7_BS (default 1):       D7 chain verify (steps=3, dtn=7)
    - otherwise:                           D5 chain verify (steps=2, dtn=5)
    
    Hysteresis (separate enter/leave thresholds) prevents prefill-burst flapping.
    Disabled by default (EAGLE_DYNAMIC_MODE=0); when enabled the worker captures
    both D5 and D7 draft graphs, scheduler picks per-step mode, eagle_worker
    dispatches via _apply_spec_config / _forward_no_spec.
    
    Touch points beyond the new spec_mode.py:
    - eagle_worker: dual-runner cuda graph capture (D5 full, D7 bs=1 only),
      per-step config swap, NO_SPEC fast path with synthetic spec_info that
      keeps draft KV in lock-step via [REDACTED]
    - cuda_graph_runner: triple-mode capture for target (DECODE + D5 verify +
      default verify), keyed by graph mode; _get_graph_key returns dtn for replay
    - minicpm_backend: per-(bs, dtn) verify metadata wrappers
    - hybrid_linear_attn_backend: per-dtn retrieve_*_list / cu_seqlens banks so
      D5/D7 captured graphs reference correctly-sized buffers
    - schedule_batch: ScheduleBatch._spec_mode field, prepare_for_decode gains
      force_no_spec for the NO_SPEC path
    - scheduler: bumps server_args.{speculative_num_draft_tokens,num_steps} to
      the larger of D5/D7 before worker init so target/draft graphs cover both
    - eval/start_eagle.sh: surfaces all EAGLE_DYNAMIC_* / EAGLE_D{5,7}_* env knobs
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```

```
1	"""Dynamic speculative-decoding mode selection for MiniCPM-SALA.
2	
3	Picks one of three modes per decode step based on the running batch size:
4	
5	    NO_SPEC      : bs >= EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS         (target_worker direct decode)
6	    MARS_D5      : default spec config            (chain verify, dtn=5 by default)
7	    MARS_D7      : bs <= EAGLE_D7_BS              (chain verify, dtn=7 by default)
8	
9	Hysteresis (separate enter/leave thresholds) prevents prefill bursts from
10	flipping NO_SPEC mid-bench. Bench traffic is monotonically decreasing on bs,
11	so transitions are essentially one-way: NO_SPEC -> MARS_D5 -> MARS_D7.
12	
13	All thresholds and per-mode spec parameters are env-driven so we can sweep
14	without rebuilding. Enable with EAGLE_DYNAMIC_MODE=1.
15	"""
16

18	import logging
19	import os
20	from dataclasses import dataclass

45	    d5_mars_theta: float       # per-mode override; -1 means "use mars_theta"
46	    d7_mars_theta: float
47

49	        return self.d5_mars_theta if self.d5_mars_theta >= 0.0 else self.mars_theta
50

55	        if not self.enabled:

57	        return (
58	            "EAGLE dynamic mode: ENABLED | "

93	        enter_no_spec_bs=_env_int("EAGLE_NO_SPEC_BS", 31),

98	        d5_steps=_env_int("EAGLE_D5_STEPS", 2),
99	        d5_dtn=_env_int("EAGLE_D5_DTN", 5),

101	        d7_steps=_env_int("EAGLE_D7_STEPS", 3),
102	        d7_dtn=_env_int("EAGLE_D7_DTN", 7),
103	        mars_theta=_env_float("EAGLE_MARS_THETA", -1.0),
104	        # Per-mode MARS theta overrides. -1 = inherit global mars_theta.
105	        # S1 (bs=1) runs entirely in D7, so a more aggressive D7 theta can
106	        # boost S1 accept-length without affecting D5/no-spec quality.
107	        d5_mars_theta=_env_float("EAGLE_D5_MARS_THETA", -1.0),
108	        d7_mars_theta=_env_float("EAGLE_D7_MARS_THETA", -1.0),
109	    )
110	    _validate(cfg)
111	    return cfg

113	
114	def _validate(cfg: SpecModeConfig) -> None:
115	    if not cfg.enabled:
116	        return
117	    if cfg.leave_no_spec_bs >= cfg.enter_no_spec_bs:
118	        logger.warning(
119	            "[spec-mode] leave_no_spec_bs(%d) >= enter_no_spec_bs(%d) disables hysteresis",
120	            cfg.leave_no_spec_bs, cfg.enter_no_spec_bs,
121	        )
122	    if cfg.leave_d7_bs <= cfg.enter_d7_bs:
123	        logger.warning(
124	            "[spec-mode] leave_d7_bs(%d) <= enter_d7_bs(%d) disables hysteresis",
125	            cfg.leave_d7_bs, cfg.enter_d7_bs,
126	        )
127	    for tag, topk, steps, dtn in (
128	        ("D5", cfg.d5_topk, cfg.d5_steps, cfg.d5_dtn),
129	        ("D7", cfg.d7_topk, cfg.d7_steps, cfg.d7_dtn),
130	    ):
131	        expected = 1 + topk * steps
132	        if dtn != expected:
133	            logger.warning(
134	                "[spec-mode] %s dtn=%d != 1+topk*steps=%d (chain verify expects equality)",
135	                tag, dtn, expected,
136	            )
137	
138	
139	class SpecModeSelector:
140	    """Pick spec mode for a decode batch based on running BS.
141	
142	    Hysteresis guards against prefill bursts re-entering NO_SPEC mid-bench;
143	    under monotonically-decreasing bs traffic, the path is effectively
144	    NO_SPEC -> MARS_D5 -> MARS_D7 with no backtracking.
145	    """
146	
147	    def __init__(self, config: SpecModeConfig):
148	        self.config = config
149	        self.current = SpecMode.MARS_D5  # initial default; first decode step overrides
150	
151	    def select(self, bs: int) -> SpecMode:
152	        cfg = self.config
153	        if not cfg.enabled:
154	            return SpecMode.MARS_D5
155	
156	        prev = self.current
157	        if prev == SpecMode.NO_SPEC:
158	            if bs <= cfg.leave_no_spec_bs:
159	                new = SpecMode.MARS_D7 if bs <= cfg.enter_d7_bs else SpecMode.MARS_D5
160	            else:
161	                new = SpecMode.NO_SPEC
162	        elif prev == SpecMode.MARS_D7:
163	            if bs >= cfg.enter_no_spec_bs:
164	                new = SpecMode.NO_SPEC
165	            elif bs >= cfg.leave_d7_bs:
166	                new = SpecMode.MARS_D5
167	            else:
168	                new = SpecMode.MARS_D7
169	        else:  # MARS_D5
170	            if bs >= cfg.enter_no_spec_bs:
171	                new = SpecMode.NO_SPEC
172	            elif bs <= cfg.enter_d7_bs:
173	                new = SpecMode.MARS_D7
174	            else:
175	                new = SpecMode.MARS_D5
176	
177	        if new != prev:
178	            logger.info("[spec-mode] %s -> %s (bs=%d)", prev.value, new.value, bs)
179	        self.current = new
180	        return new
181	
182	
183	def selector_from_env() -> SpecModeSelector:
184	    cfg = load_config()
185	    logger.info("[spec-mode] %s", cfg.summary())
186	    return SpecModeSelector(cfg)
187
```

```
487	        """Run speculative decoding forward.
488	
489	        NOTE: Many states of batch is modified as you go through. It is not guaranteed that
490	        the final output batch have the same state as the input.
491	
492	        Args:
493	            batch: The batch to run forward. The state of the batch is modified as it runs.
494	        Returns:
495	            A tuple of the final logit output of the target model, next tokens accepted,
496	            the batch id (used for overlap schedule), and number of accepted tokens.
497	        """
498	        if batch.forward_mode.is_extend() or batch.is_extend_in_batch:
499	            logits_output, next_token_ids, seq_lens_cpu = self.forward_target_extend(
500	                batch
501	            )

560	    def _apply_spec_config(self, mode: SpecMode) -> None:
561	        """Switch worker spec config (topk / steps / dtn) and active draft graph.
562	
563	        No-op if dynamic mode disabled or mode is the same as last applied. The
564	        draft attn_backend is shared across modes (sized to ``_max_spec_steps``
565	        at init); only the cuda-graph runner buffers differ.
566	        """
567	        cfg = self.spec_mode_config
568	        if not cfg.enabled:
569	            return
570	        if mode == SpecMode.MARS_D5:
571	            new_topk, new_steps, new_dtn = cfg.d5_topk, cfg.d5_steps, cfg.d5_dtn
572	            new_runner = self.cuda_graph_runner_d5
573	        elif mode == SpecMode.MARS_D7:
574	            new_topk, new_steps, new_dtn = cfg.d7_topk, cfg.d7_steps, cfg.d7_dtn
575	            new_runner = self.cuda_graph_runner_d7

602	    def _forward_no_spec(self, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> GenerationBatchResult:
603	        """Run target_worker direct decode and refresh draft KV with one token.
604	
605	        Skips draft/verify entirely. Then runs a single 1-token DRAFT_EXTEND so
606	        the draft KV / GLA state advance lock-step with target — this lets us
607	        switch back to MARS_D5/D7 on the next step without any cold-start gap.
608	        """
609	        # 0. Scheduler's prepare_for_decode() early-returned because spec is
610	        #    enabled — that meant EAGLE.draft() was expected to allocate the KV
611	        #    slots. We're skipping draft, so run the full non-spec body now to
612	        #    allocate (bs,) dense KV slots, advance seq_lens, set input_ids.
613	        # Clear any stale spec_info.positions BEFORE building model_worker_batch:
614	        # the previous step's prepare_extend_after_decode left positions sized
615	        # to the prior bs. ForwardBatch.init_new copies spec_info.positions
616	        # verbatim when set, so a stale length crashes target's input_buffers
617	        # at copy time. NO_SPEC doesn't need spec-supplied positions —
618	        # clamp_position(seq_lens) is the right default for DECODE.
619	        if isinstance(batch.spec_info, EagleDraftInput):
620	            batch.spec_info.positions = None
621	        batch.prepare_for_decode(force_no_spec=True)
622	
623	        # 1. Target direct decode, capture FULL hidden so we can feed draft.
624	        #    Why FULL not LAST: target's cuda_graph_runner ends capture with
625	        #    self.capture_hidden_mode=FULL (last value set during verify
626	        #    capture path; EagleVerifyInput.capture_hidden_mode default=FULL).
627	        #    can_run() requires requested == self.capture_hidden_mode, so a
628	        #    LAST request misses the captured graph and falls back to eager
629	        #    (the "cuda graph: False" we observed). Under DECODE forward mode
630	        #    each req has 1 token, so FULL collapses to the same (bs, hidden)
631	        #    tensor as LAST — semantically equivalent for downstream draft.
632	        batch.return_hidden_states = True
633	        model_worker_batch = batch.get_model_worker_batch()
634	        model_worker_batch.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.FULL
635	        target_result = self.target_worker.forward_batch_generation(
636	            model_worker_batch
637	        )
638	        last_hidden = target_result.logits_output.hidden_states
639	        next_token_ids = target_result.next_token_ids
640	        bs = next_token_ids.shape[0]
641	
642	        # 2. Stash a synthetic "verify accepted 1 token" spec_info on the batch
643	        #    so forward_draft_extend_after_decode() can consume it normally.
644	        if not isinstance(batch.spec_info, EagleDraftInput):
645	            batch.spec_info = EagleDraftInput()
646	        batch.spec_info.verified_id = next_token_ids
647	        batch.spec_info.hidden_states = last_hidden
648	        # accept_length here = "extra accepted draft tokens beyond the user_4813494d".
649	        # NO_SPEC has no draft tree, only the 1 user_4813494d token in next_token_ids,
650	        # so accept_length must be 0 — prepare_extend_after_decode does
651	        # extend_lens = [x + 1 for x in accept_length_cpu], and verified_id
652	        # has bs elements; mismatched extend_lens leaks draft KV slots.
653	        batch.spec_info.accept_length = torch.zeros(
654	            bs, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device
655	        )
656	        batch.spec_info.accept_length_cpu = [0] * bs
657	        batch.spec_info.capture_hidden_mode = CaptureHiddenMode.LAST
658	        # prepare_extend_after_decode reads these to set batch.seq_lens etc.
659	        batch.spec_info.seq_lens_for_draft_extend = batch.seq_lens.clone()
660	        batch.spec_info.seq_lens_for_draft_extend_cpu = batch.seq_lens_cpu.clone()
661	        batch.spec_info.req_pool_indices_for_draft_extend = batch.req_pool_indices
662	
663	        # 3. Advance draft KV by 1 token so spec resumption is seamless.
664	        #    forward_draft_extend_after_decode → capture_for_decode resets
665	        #    spec_info.hidden_states to draft-output size (~4096), restoring
666	        #    the merge_batch invariant.
667	        with self.draft_tp_context(
668	            self.draft_model_runner.tp_group
669	        ), speculative_moe_backend_context(), speculative_moe_a2a_backend_context():
670	            self.forward_draft_extend_after_decode(batch)
671	
672	        # 4. Mirror verify()'s post-sample bookkeeping: append accepted token,
673	        #    run check_finished (otherwise NO_SPEC reqs never finish because
674	        #    process_batch_result_decode skips append for spec algos), then
675	        #    filter spec_info to unfinished only so the next filter_batch
676	        #    pass sees matching shapes.
677	        next_token_cpu = next_token_ids.tolist()
678	        unfinished_index: List[int] = []
679	        for i, req in enumerate(batch.reqs):
680	            req.output_ids.append(next_token_cpu[i])
681	            req.check_finished()
682	            if not req.finished():
683	                unfinished_index.append(i)
684	            req.spec_verify_ct += 1
685	
686	        if len(unfinished_index) < bs:
687	            keep = torch.tensor(
688	                unfinished_index, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.device
689	            )
690	            si = batch.spec_info
691	            if si.topk_p is not None:
692	                si.topk_p = si.topk_p[keep]
693	            if si.topk_index is not None:
694	                si.topk_index = si.topk_index[keep]
695	            if si.hidden_states is not None:
696	                si.hidden_states = si.hidden_states[keep]
697	            si.verified_id = si.verified_id[keep]
698	            si.accept_length = si.accept_length[keep]
699	            si.accept_length_cpu = [si.accept_length_cpu[i] for i in unfinished_index]
700	
701	        # num_accepted_tokens here means *draft* tokens accepted (user_4813494d not
702	        # counted) — NO_SPEC ran no draft, so 0. The output_processor then
703	        # does num_generated_tokens += bs (user_4813494d) outside this path; spec
704	        # metrics use 0 to avoid inflating accept_length / accept_rate /
705	        # gen_throughput by 2x. accept_length_per_req_cpu holds the same
```

```
1306	    def _alloc_sparse_for_new_positions(
1307	        self, batch: ScheduleBatch, seq_lens_before_cpu: torch.Tensor
1308	    ):
1309	        """Allocate sparse k1/k2 slots for positions crossed during this decode round.
1310	
1311	        MiniCPM-SALA uses InfLLM-v2 sparse attention for standard layers.
1312	        Normal decode allocates sparse slots in alloc_for_decode, but EAGLE
1313	        skips that path. We must allocate them here so cache_finished_req's
1314	        sparse free matches what was allocated.
1315	
1316	        seq_lens_before_cpu: CPU tensor of seq_lens before verify (avoids GPU sync).
1317	        """
1318	        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import (
1319	            MiniCPMReqToTokenPool,
1320	            MiniCPMHybridReqToTokenPool,
1321	        )
1322	
1323	        rtp = self.req_to_token_pool
1324	        if not isinstance(rtp, (MiniCPMReqToTokenPool, MiniCPMHybridReqToTokenPool)):
1325	            return
1326	
1327	        kernel_size = rtp.kernel_size
1328	        kernel_stride = rtp.kernel_stride
1329	        bs = batch.batch_size()
1330	
1331	        # Use CPU tensors to avoid GPU sync from .item() calls
1332	        new_sl_list = batch.seq_lens_cpu.tolist()
1333	        old_sl_list = seq_lens_before_cpu.tolist()
1334	
1335	        for i in range(bs):
1336	            old_sl = old_sl_list[i]
1337	            new_sl = new_sl_list[i]
1338	
1339	            # k1: positions where sl >= kernel_size and (sl - kernel_size) % kernel_stride == 0
1340	            for sl in range(max(old_sl + 1, kernel_size), new_sl + 1):
1341	                if (sl - kernel_size) % kernel_stride == 0:
1342	                    k1_idx = (sl - kernel_size) // kernel_stride
1343	                    loc = alloc_token_slots(batch.tree_cache, 1)
1344	                    rtp.write_sparse_k1(
1345	                        (batch.req_pool_indices[i], (k1_idx, k1_idx + 1)),
1346	                        loc.to(torch.int32),
1347	                    )
1348	
1349	            # k2: kernel_size*4, kernel_stride*4
1350	            k2_ks = kernel_size * 4
1351	            k2_stride = kernel_stride * 4
1352	            for sl in range(max(old_sl + 1, k2_ks), new_sl + 1):
1353	                if (sl - k2_ks) % k2_stride == 0:
1354	                    k2_idx = (sl - k2_ks) // k2_stride
1355	                    loc = alloc_token_slots(batch.tree_cache, 1)
1356	                    rtp.write_sparse_k2(
1357	                        (batch.req_pool_indices[i], (k2_idx, k2_idx + 1)),
1358	                        loc.to(torch.int32),
1359	                    )
```
